sentences.en: They kicked him out of the disco without any explanation.
sentences.zh: 他们没有说明原因就把他赶出了迪斯科舞会。

sentences.en: You may not even go to the disco at all.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可能根本不会去迪斯科舞会。

sentences.en: She likes dancing in a disco better than skiing.
sentences.zh: 她更喜欢在迪斯科舞会上跳舞而不是滑雪。

senses.zh: 迪斯科舞厅，迪斯科舞会,的士高
